t: What he told them after the money arrived
a: فَأَبْشِرُوا وَأَمِّلُوا مَا يَسُرُّكُمْ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا الْفَقْرَ أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ
p: Fa-abshirū wa ammilū mā yasurrukum, fa-wa-Llāhi mā-l-faqra akhshā ʿalaykum
m: So take good news, and hope for what will please you. By Allah, it is not poverty I fear for you.
